svg.aria-label: Two ways to buy headroom, side by side. On the left, the upgrade ladder: twelve dollars for one vCPU, twenty-four for two, forty-eight for four, ninety-six for eight. The three upgrade rungs are struck through, because the bill recurs every month for ever. On the right, moving the work: the same twelve dollar machine, with a one-second cache inside the application taking the ceiling from two thousand five hundred to four thousand users, and the same rule moved into the proxy taking it to five thousand two hundred and fifty. That is 2.1 times the users for no change to the bill. The closing caption says to measure what saturated before paying for more of it, because the feed was the same answer for nearly everybody and was being recomputed for every request.
